Hoagie Haven is a platform now! We have lined up a string of strategic hoagie partners who want to help us bring our hoagies to the world. There's more partners just waiting to get in on the action and we want to facilitate their adoption of our platform to further our mission of putting a hoagie in every mouth globally!

## Background

Task 1029, 1030, and 1031 build out our platform API for authentication, ordering hoagies, and invoicing.

## Deliverable

Building on your work from Task 1029, Task 1030, and Task 1031\*, we want to publish API docs for our existing API.

API documentation should clearly state the expected inputs and outputs for a given inputs, and expected HTTP status codes.

These docs should be publicly available.

In exchange for forgoing your bonus this year, management has graciously agreed that accessing these docs does not incur a fee even if the accessor is an authenticated partner.
